content.title: Trustmark (NASDAQ:TRMK) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q4 CY2025
content.summary: Regional banking company Trustmark (NASDAQ:TRMK) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 5.2% year on year to $207.1 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 6.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Trustmark: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: The average estimate of four analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for earnings of 91 cents per share. The holding company for Trustmark National Bank posted revenue of $283.5 million in the period. Its revenue net of interest expense was $207.1 million, also beating Street forecasts.
